segments.contextAfter: Pick a camera resolution that’s appropriate for the size of object you want to track. For small objects, like a tennis or cricket ball, you may need 1080p resolution to achieve the results you want. Tracking larger objects, like a soccer ball, may require only VGA resolution for optimal results. Vision downscales the movie as needed, based on the minimum object size, to improve performance.
